subject: Observability blueprint & success metrics for Nova Financial POC
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodai.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@novafin.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodai.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 14:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Observability blueprint & success metrics for Nova Financial POC

Alex — thanks for the conversation today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align the POC plan and get the trial running next week. 

High-level objective
- Validate: consistent 99th-percentile latency < 350ms on 2k concurrent inference requests and no regression in prediction quality for our 3 canonical prompts.

Success criteria (what Nova will sign off on)
- Latency: p99 < 350ms across 1k steady QPS and < 500ms for 2k burst for the selected model variant.
- Throughput: able to sustain 2k concurrent requests for 30 minutes without errors.
- Cost baseline: token/unit cost estimate collected and a sample dashboard for cost per 1k tokens.
- Quality: model responses score >= 0.85 on your scoring rubric for the three prompt families in the sample set.
- Observability: we need dashboards showing token breakdown, per-route latency, error rate, and KV cache hit rate. Tracing for tail latency and a log export to your SIEM.

Proposed evaluation plan & timeline
- Wed 4/21: access exchange — API keys, log-forwarding endpoint, and SRE contact.
- Thu 4/22–Fri 4/23: import sample prompts & run smoke tests.
- Mon 4/26–Fri 4/30: controlled load test (sustained QPS windows + bursts).
- Mon 5/3: joint review + sign-off against success criteria.

Owner matrix (who does what)
- Redwood: Jonas (observability config, dashboards, tracing instrument), Evelyn (sales/POC oversight).
- Nova: Alex (product owner), Security Ops (sec/compliance and log ingestion).
- Integration partner (optional): Mark Lin (if we need assistance with on-prem log forwarder).

Observability checklist (initial) — what we need from Nova
1) Log export endpoint (syslog/HTTPS) and TLS cert details.
2) Sample payloads and canonical prompts (we already have a subset; please add edge-case examples).
3) Access to a test VPC or a staging collector for trace spans (span sampling rate request: 10% for first run).
4) Slack/SRE on-call for the 4/26 stress window.

Attachments: I attached a short metrics template (poc-success-metrics.xlsx) and a network diagram stub.

Next steps / asks for you
- Could you confirm the Security Ops contact and whether we can send a test syslog on 4/21?
- Please confirm the three prompts you want scored and attach the scoring rubric if possible.

Thanks — I’ll schedule the kickoff once you confirm.

—
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions, Redwood Inference
[e] evelyn.hart@redwoodai.com | [m] +1 415-555-0198
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@novafin.com>

Subject: Re: Observability blueprint & success metrics for Nova Financial POC

Thanks, Evelyn — this is exactly what we needed. Quick confirmations and a couple clarifications: 

- Security Ops contact: secops@novafin.com (primary: Rita Chen). They gave tentative approval for a TLS-protected HTTPS endpoint for log forwarding; they want us to work through your security checklist before enabling.
- For prompts: attaching the rubric (we'll add edge-case examples by EOD Monday).
- Sampling: 10% span sampling is fine for the first run. If we see noisy traces we'll reduce.
- Can you provide the exact JSON schema for the trace spans and the field names you expect for request_id/route/model_variant? That will speed our instrumentation.

We can accept a test syslog on 4/21 after a short security review. We also have an internal contact for the VPC collector (mark.lin@integration-partner.com) — Mark helps with on-prem forwarding.

Attachment: rubric_v1.pdf

Appreciate it — we want to keep the review meeting on 5/3.

Alex
Product Lead, Nova Financial

- Action: Laura — can you own the HubSpot deal health updates and confirm we have the dedicated trial cluster ready for 4/26? We need autoscaling policy set to allow the burst window.
- Action: Evelyn — confirm the kickoff once Alex confirms rubric and Security Ops gives a green light for 4/21 test forward.

Also attaching a short internal checklist I use for POCs (redwood-observability-checklist.pdf).

Jonas

Thanks — infra ops confirmed cluster reservation 4/25–5/03 (dedicated trial cluster). Notes from infra: 
- Autoscaling policy: base 4 GPUs, burst to 10 for 30m windows.
- KV cache visibility: we can export cache hit metrics to the Grafana metrics endpoint (metric name: redwood.kv_cache.hit_ratio).
- Log forwarding: accepted formats: syslog RFC5424 or HTTPS JSON (schema we received from Jonas).

Infra requests that Nova provide a temporary test certificate for HTTPS forwarding or that Mark Lin's team set up a collector in their VPC (preferred for corp policies).

I'll mark the HubSpot deal with the POC kickoff on 4/21 once we have the test endpoint and rubric.

Laura Bennett
